existing_features.title: Add the built mobile wrapper artifacts to the exact static paths expected by the app so the Downloads screen can show real, working download links: `frontend/public/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.apk` and `frontend/public/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.ipa` (served at `/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.apk` and `/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.ipa`).

On the `/downloads` page, when an artifact is available, display a visible, copyable direct URL for each artifact in addition to the download button (e.g., `/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.apk` and `/assets/mobile/dist/SafeSpace.ipa`).

new_feature_requests.summary: Generate and provide actual download links for the built app (build/deployment artifact delivery)

projectName: Provide actual in-app download links for Android APK and iOS IPA
